slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will keep you
calm in any chaos

slow swimming

swim slow lengths once a week, focusing only on your breathing. water muffles the noise of the world, and an hour in it leaves your nervous system quieter for days.

jigsaw puzzles

keep a big jigsaw puzzle on a table and add a few pieces every evening. it's slow, quiet and impossible to rush, which is exactly what an anxious mind needs.

knitting

learn to knit, even just simple scarves. repeating the same small movement over and over calms the mind in the way meditation promises and doesn't always deliver.

a calm daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning about something far bigger than your problems: the age of the stars, the deep ocean, ancient empires. perspective is the calmest feeling there is.
slides.texte_sophia:
a calm daily lesson

i used to spiral about small problems. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: the stars, the deep ocean, ancient empires. perspective is the calmest feeling there is.

slides.texte_overlay:
long walks at dusk

walk for half an hour as the sun goes down, a few times a week. the slow change of light settles your mind and makes the whole evening feel calmer and softer.
